Separate interlinear and side-by-side writing units are counted in lines_read.

changes.place: Opening, immediately after défini
changes.ink: After the final dotted i of défini there is a clear gap followed directly by the low initial m/u strokes of multiplication. No separate a body or accent occupies that gap. The later à before gauche is distinct and remains.

changes.place: Opening, after à gauche
changes.ink: The dark retraced gauche ends at the right edge of the first line. The next line begins par. No près is written between them. The darker word still reads gauche; no older word can be recovered confidently beneath its retracing.

changes.place: Opening abbreviation

changes.ink: The initial capital O and short n, then the p descender and joined body of passe, are visible. The small accented à separates u from int(g) circle u. The baseline en remains before remplaçant; gardant p, et en is written above as an insertion attached there. Both g descenders in gg_i are plain. A small detached hook after the inserted en is retained only as a local punctuation/pen-trace doubt, not a certain comma.

changes.place: First preliminary formula, both g_i exponents
changes.ink: Both very small exponent areas are dark angular masses. Extra upstrokes favor cancellation over a clean written minus followed by1, but the second is especially compact; the live-state alternative cannot be excluded. The underlying minus1 is itself doubtful. Both glyph and state alternatives are therefore explicit at each position.
changes.math_consequence: The exponent state is not decided from either conjugation convention.

changes.place: Second preliminary formula, both h_i exponents
changes.ink: Each h_i has a short raised dark mass with several angular strokes. The last has multiple extra upward ticks, favoring a scribbled cancellation. Neither underlying minus1 is fully legible; live versus cancelled remains an explicit alternative. The final pq is followed by no comma.

changes.place: (23), two inverse-exponent positions in the main argument
changes.ink: The two exponent traces have black angled upper strokes beyond the expected two characters. Cancellation is favored but not absolute; their residual glyphs remain unsure minus1. The underlying factors v(g_i) and h_i are not themselves struck.

changes.place: (23), cancelled upper annotation and its supporting straight bar

changes.place: (23), terminal punctuation

Si $v$ est donné par $q,(h_i)$, on a
\[
vu(l_i)=v(\operatorname{int}(g_i^{\unsure{\deleted{\unsure{-1}}|\unsure{-1}}})l_i^p)=\operatorname{int}(v(g_i^{\unsure{\deleted{\unsure{-1}}|\unsure{-1}}}))v(l_i)^p

\[
